column3: vi. 逃避工作, 游手好闲;n. 假金砖, 赝品, 懒汉
column5: The sergeant has no patience with recruits who goldbrick on long marches.
column6: 中士绝不容忍新兵在长途行军中偷奸耍滑。

column3: v. 狼吞虎咽;n. 讲究饮食, 大吃大喝
column5: The travel writers gormandized their way through the port city's seafood stalls.
column6: 旅行作家们一路大快朵颐,吃遍港城的海鲜排档。

column3: n. 尝味, 味觉;味觉, 尝味
column5: Professional tasting depends on trained gustation rather than simple appetite.
column6: 专业品鉴靠的是训练有素的味觉,而非一时的口腹之欲。

column3: v. 狼吞虎咽地吃喝
column5: The boys guttled the sandwiches within minutes of the picnic starting.
column6: 野餐刚开始几分钟,男孩们便狼吞虎咽吃光了三明治。

column3: n. 妇女当政, 女权政治
column5: Some anthropologists cite the island tribe as a rare historical gynaecocracy.
column6: 一些人类学家把这个海岛部落视为史上罕见的妇女掌权社会。

column3: a. 不认真的, 无兴趣的, 不热心的
column5: A halfhearted apology only deepened the insult in the victim's eyes.
column6: 在受害者看来,敷衍了事的道歉只会加重羞辱。

column3: a. 顽强的, 坚韧的
column5: The hardbitten reporter had covered four wars before her thirtieth birthday.
column6: 这位百炼成钢的记者三十岁前就报道过四场战争。

column3: n. 胆大无敌, 刚毅, 厚颜, 强壮
column5: Crossing the pass in January demanded real hardihood from the mail carriers.
column6: 一月翻越山口,对邮差们的胆识与耐力是真正的考验。

column3: a. 令人心碎的, 悲惨的
column5: The documentary closes with a heartrending interview with the last surviving villager.
column6: 纪录片以对最后一位在世村民的锥心访谈收尾。

column3: n. 希洛人(古斯巴达奴隶), 奴隶, 农奴
column5: The rebels were treated as helots rather than citizens after the surrender.
column6: 投降之后,起义者被当作奴隶而非公民对待。

column3: n. 柄;vt. 装柄于
column5: He swung the axe by its worn helve until his palms ached.
column6: 他握着磨旧的斧柄挥斧,直到两手发疼。

column3: n. 止血钳子, 止血剂;止血器, 止血剂
column5: The surgeon clamped the small vessel with a hemostat before continuing.
column6: 外科医生用止血钳夹住小血管,然后继续手术。

column3: a. 怕老婆的, 惧内的, 老婆当家的
column5: The comic play presents a henpecked baker who hides in the flour cellar.
column6: 这出喜剧讲一个怕老婆的面包师躲进面粉窖的故事。

column3: n. 同形异义字
column5: The metal lead and the verb lead form a classic homograph pair.
column6: 作为金属的 lead 与作为动词的 lead 是典型的同形词。

column3: n. 测时法, 钟表制造术
column5: He studied horology in Switzerland before restoring the cathedral's famous clock.
column6: 他在瑞士修习钟表学,后来修复了大教堂的名钟。

column3: a. 劝告的, 奖励的
column5: The coach's hortative speech sent the team onto the field roaring.
column6: 教练鼓劲的讲话让全队吼着冲上球场。

column3: vt. 把…奉为偶像；盲目崇拜
column5: Some fans idolatrize celebrities to an unhealthy degree, psychologists warn.
column6: 心理学家警告,一些粉丝对名人的偶像崇拜已到病态程度。

column3: vi. 迫近, 威胁, 悬挂
column5: As the spring flood impended, the city filled sandbags through the night.
column6: 春汛逼近,全城连夜装填沙袋。

column3: a. 不知悔改的, 顽固的;n. 不知悔改的人, 顽固的人
column5: The impenitent official blamed the press for the scandal he himself caused.
column6: 那名毫无悔意的官员把自己惹出的丑闻归咎于媒体。

column3: n. 无力, 虚弱, 无能
column5: The commission's impuissance was exposed when its subpoenas were simply ignored.
column6: 传票被公然置之不理,委员会的软弱无力暴露无遗。

column3: a. 微不足道的
column5: The difference between the two samples was too inappreciable to affect the results.
column6: 两份样本之间的差异微乎其微,不影响结果。

column3: n. 不确实, 无信心, 不安全
column5: Months of incertitude about funding wore down the research staff.
column6: 经费悬而未决的数月里,研究人员身心俱疲。

column3: a. 无思想的；粗心的；不体谅的
column5: His incogitant remark about rural voters nearly sank the campaign.
column6: 他一句欠考虑的关于农村选民的失言差点葬送竞选。

column3: n. 屡教不改, 难望矫正
column5: The boy's incorrigibility finally exhausted the patience of every teacher in the school.
column6: 这男孩屡教不改,终于磨光了全校老师的耐心。

column3: n. 用硬壳包, 镶嵌, 痂, 硬壳;结痂, 痂
column5: Restorers removed centuries of incrustation from the fountain's marble basin.
column6: 修复人员清除了喷泉大理石盆上几个世纪的积垢。

column3: vt. 使负罪, 控告, 使连累;控告, 连累, 归罪于
column5: The seized ledger served to inculpate three senior managers in the scheme.
column6: 被查扣的账本成为指控三名高管卷入骗局的证据。

column3: pl. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标
column5: Both economic indices rose sharply after the central bank cut rates.
column6: 央行降息之后,两项经济指数双双大幅上扬。

column3: vt. 使硬化, 使无感觉, 使确立;a. 顽固的, 冷酷的
column5: His palms, indurated by decades of rope work, hardly felt the thorns.
column6: 他的手掌因数十年缆绳活磨出硬茧,几乎不怕荆棘。

column3: a. 酒醉的;n. 酒鬼
column5: A cheerful inebriate led the pub in a wavering chorus at closing time.
column6: 打烊时分,一个乐呵呵的醉汉领着满馆客人跑了调地合唱。

column3: a. 不能消除的, 不能抹掉的
column5: The famine left an ineffaceable mark on the nation's collective memory.
column6: 那场饥荒在民族集体记忆中留下了无法磨灭的烙印。
